purpose: Browser handling, co-op road width, finite impact feedback and navigator latency fixes.

nativeReference.source: Installed Left! Left! LEFT! Playtest, recovered serialized level1/level2/level3 GoofyCarController and road data
nativeReference.authoredRoads: Original meshes and varying strip widths are retained unchanged, including the original start and finish poses.

changes: Added procedural co-op roads use 5m and their matching boundary trees move inward; procedural four-player race roads retain 9.5m.
Speed-dependent native steering lock, wheelbase, damped steering and bounded yaw replace excessive high-speed lock.
Driver and navigator use continuous fixed-step presentation; navigator keys cannot drive, and remote held inputs expire.
Prediction covers the full frame interval at 20fps rather than losing simulation time to a 40ms cap.
TREE'D and finished result cameras do not shake; moving car impacts have a bounded local 450ms envelope.
Queued continuous input is selected after an outstanding poll completes; the latest turn and discrete actions survive.
Race packets no longer rebuild the hidden lobby or update browser history.
Auto graphics adapts pixel ratio to sustained frame rate, and only nearby forest chunks cast dynamic shadows.
Steering and mouse sensitivity are adjustable in Esc > Settings and saved locally.

additionalChecks: Four real HTTP clients and WebSocket clients
Navigator controls isolated from driver prediction

integration: Mac audio, original pause UI and original-course commits were merged and preserved. No audio source or audio tests were changed by this work.
limits: This ports serialized handling parameters into the browser bicycle model; it is not the native Unity suspension, tyre solver or a claim of identical feel.
Automated HTTP routes use the internal fixture clock; the delayed-response check uses wall time.
No new manual visual playtest, measured GPU frame-rate comparison or two-computer internet test has been completed by these checks.
Everyone should refresh the browser page and create a new room after deployment so client and server handling match.
